verdict.rationale: Canva documents public REST APIs: the Connect APIs for designs, assets, comments, exports and Brand Template autofill, plus the SCIM, Admin and audit-log APIs. It also publishes an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs, and an llms.txt index is live. The probe's 404s at standard OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented spec; it is simply hosted elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, the OpenAPI spec at a discoverable standard path, and private integrations being limited to Enterprise plans.
